Cat gestation (mean about 65 days, range 52–74): review, [PMC7103129](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7103129); UK pedigree survey of 1,056 litters, [PMC10832861](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10832861); questionnaire of 197 queens, [Utrecht research portal](https://research-portal.uu.nl/en/publications/questionnaire-based-survey-of-parturition-in-the-queen/); research colony, [PubMed 8542362](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8542362/).

Dromedary gestation (about 12–13 months): [IVIS, Theriogenology in Camelidae: Parturition](https://www.ivis.org/library/theriogenology-camelidae-anatomy-physiology-pathology-and-artificial-breeding/parturition); [Vet. Med. Mosul review](https://www.vetmedmosul.com/article_189570.html).

Camel dentition (upper incisors I3 caniniform; deciduous incisors): [Assiut University, dentition of the dromedary](https://www.aun.edu.eg/veterinary_medicine/history-dentition-camels-camelus-dromedarius); [PMC10472607](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC10472607/).

Lagomorph caecotrophy versus rumination: [cuniculture.info, Biology of the rabbit, ch. 4](https://www.cuniculture.info/Docs/Biologie/Biology-English/caecotrophy%20Coprophagy.htm); [Journal of Zoology, digestive strategies in two lagomorphs](https://core-cms.cambridgecore.org/core/journals/journal-of-zoology/article/digestive-strategies-in-two-sympatrically-occurring-lagomorphs/C727753024C0D3E6B693C3B2740B2AA7).

Blind mole-rat eye and circadian photoreception: [PMC61113 (Avivi et al. 2001, PNAS)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC61113/); [Haifa, spectral tuning of a circadian photopigment in Spalax](https://cris.haifa.ac.il/en/publications/spectral-tuning-of-a-circadian-photopigment-in-a-subterranean-bli-2/); [Haifa, reduced eye size and photoperiodic system](https://cris.haifa.ac.il/en/publications/consequences-of-reduced-eye-size-on-the-visual-and-photoperiodic-/).

Hyrax rumination/merycism: H. Hendrichs, 'Wiederkauen bei Klippschliefern und Känguruhs', Naturwissenschaften 50 (1963) 454–455, [doi:10.1007/BF00601614](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF00601614); the counter-view (hyraxes do not ruminate, jaw motions with empty mouth), J. Garrido, 'Tres persistentes falacias zoológicas', Panace@ 16/41 (2015), [PDF](https://www.tremedica.org/wp-content/uploads/n41_tribuna_garrido.pdf); the Hoek and Janis comments as quoted in the [Parshablog discussion](http://parsha.blogspot.com/2013/07/review-of-enigma-of-biblical-shafan-pt.html) (secondary).

Mule versus hinny: [Wikipedia, Hinny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hinny); [Rural Heritage, Mule or Hinny?](https://ruralheritage.com/mule-or-hinny-2/); [Redwings, a-mule-zing differences (PDF)](https://www.redwings.org.uk/sites/default/files/2023-09/a-mule-zing%20differences.pdf); [The Donkey Sanctuary Canada FAQ](https://www.thedonkeysanctuary.ca/frequently-ass-ked-questions/).

Dog gastric emptying and gut transit: [PMC3390132](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3390132); [Petfood Industry, body weight and GI transit times in dogs](https://www.petfoodindustry.com/articles/1806-body-weight-and-gi-transit-times-in-dogs).

Bat birth timing: [PMC11499213 (northern bats)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC11499213/); [Pagepress, captive Pipistrellus births](https://biology.pagepress.org/tz/article/download/68/67); [Pixcams, big brown bat births](https://pixcams.com/eyes-on-the-colony-a-wild-bat-birth-may-soon-make-history-at-the-schwarz-barn/).

Mares foal at night (about 80%): [equine-behaviour.de reference 984](https://references.equine-behaviour.de/show.php?record=984); [Univ. Bern, Theriogenology 2022 (PDF)](https://boris.unibe.ch/171797/1/1-s2.0-S0093691X22002643-main.pdf).

Gestation tables (wolf 63 d, lion about 108 d, fox 52 d, and others): [MSD Veterinary Manual, approximate gestation periods](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/veterinary/multimedia/table/approximate-gestation-periods).

Pig gestation: [Cambridge, Large White pedigree herd (mean 114.17 d)](https://resolve.cambridge.org/core/journals/journal-of-agricultural-science/article/observations-on-reproduction-in-a-pedigree-herd-of-large-white-pigs/13B11EC755B7202EF2999AB7B76E60CB); [DOAJ, commercial crossbred sows (mean 117.6 d)](https://doaj.org/article/9d47e585d33f4b30b4151ea981078dc9).
Brown bear delayed implantation and gestation: [PMC4079694](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4079694). Elephant 22 months: [National Geographic](https://on.natgeo.com/2Xx7DFv).
Stoat delayed implantation: [YPTE stoat factsheet](https://ypte.org.uk/factsheets/stoat/breeding); [Bioscience Proceedings, captive stoats](https://www.biosciproceedings.org/BP/0010/bp0010ised14).

Adder gestation and biennial breeding: [PMC6511386 (PeerJ 2019)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6511386/); [Journal of Herpetology, annual reproduction in montane adders](https://bioone.org/journals/journal-of-herpetology/volume-48/issue-4/12-253/Annual-Reproduction-in-Female-Adders-Vipera-berus-from-a-Montane/10.1670/12-253.full).

Paralytic rabies in dogs (dropped jaw, salivation, voice change): [MSD Animal Health rabies info (PDF)](https://www.msd-animal-health.ie/wp-content/uploads/sites/12/2022/12/RabiesDiseasesInfoNobivac.pdf); [JIDC 2024 case report](https://jidc.org/index.php/journal/article/view/39078786).

Bird eyelids (lower lid closes the eye; owls the exception): [BMC Veterinary Research 2025](https://bmcvetres.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12917-025-04677-0); [SciELO, avian ophthalmic peculiarities](https://scielo.br/j/cr/a/vKbx94N4YVSMhDFMqqXRfCy/?lang=en).

Not yet sourced one by one (standard reference values): hen incubation, leopard, hyena and macaque gestation, sheep/goat/cattle/horse/donkey gestation, oviparous snake incubation, bat and lagomorph anatomy, hyena pseudo-penis and anal pouch, cat latrine behaviour, cattle tail-switching, goats leading flocks, and indeterminate growth in fish and snakes.
